title: Paper-assembly scaffolding (claim JSON → markdown skeleton)
author: Pukujan
body_excerpt:
## Goal

Deterministic template assembler that turns classify claim JSON records into a medium-quality markdown research-paper skeleton with provenance, lineage, and citations sections.

## Scope

**In**

- Assembler module: claim JSON records → markdown paper skeleton (title/abstract/claims/provenance/lineage/citations).
- Prose templates are **code/strings only** for v1 — **NO non-JEV LLM** for…
